info.name: 🛒 Ecommerce MVP — Complete API Suite
info.description:
Full API test suite for Spring Boot Kotlin E-Commerce MVP.

## Setup
1. Import this collection
2. Import the `ecommerce-local.environment.json` environment file
3. Select the `ecommerce-local` environment
4. Start your Spring Boot app on port 8080
5. Run the **🔐 1. Auth / Login (User)** and **Login (Admin)** requests first
6. Then use Collection Runner to execute the full suite in order

## Auth Strategy
- User token → stored as `access_token`
- Admin token → stored as `admin_token`
- Admin requests swap token via Pre-request Script automatically

## Order Status Flow
TO_PAY → CONFIRMED → PROCESSING → SHIPPED → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED → RECEIVED
